# Fabrewk project settings: the policy a maestro adopts with Fabrewk (`fabrewk adopt`). A change takes
# effect only when a maestro adopts it. Commented keys are proposals, not decisions.

[project]
name = "Fabrewk"

[maintainers.xel]
role = "maestro"
key = "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIMpNfw3yY4sb7CO5xUCEfRQuPtw6UlYial7Y/MWCHFVf xel@fabrewk"

[languages]
canonicalDocumentationLanguage = "en"
documentationLanguages = ["en", "es-MX"]

[tools.claude]
adapter = "claude-code"
providers = ["anthropic"]

[tools.codex]
adapter = "codex"
providers = ["openai"]

[providers.anthropic]
allowed = true

[providers.openai]
allowed = true

say.text: Importo el registro del bootstrap: cierro la construcción a mano de Fabrewk, adopto la configuración de producción y dejo el alambique actual como base.
